text: LER adapts DeFi liquid staking to e-commerce by paying consumptive utilities instead of speculative yields, and it is this substitution of consumption for yield that mitigates volatility risk.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054
abstract: This LER mechanism derives in part from DeFi liquid staking, where users earn yields without sacrificing tradability of the underlying asset, but LER adapts it to e-commerce ecosystems by focusing on consumptive utilities rather than speculative yields, thus mitigating volatility risks.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: rewards redeemable only within merchant ecosystems
